about: Review of a chess.com game still being played, behind a developer switch that ships off. Graded by gate 176 (TC-R247a..h) on a trial bundle at 375x761 with his insets and at 320x568, with every chess.com request answered by the gate's own route: with the switch off, and for a player with the switch's key set by hand, nothing shows and the in-progress list is never asked for; with it on the Daily games in progress are listed, a game one of his accounts plays in opens as a live review like any other (his Desk answer to q24 call (1), 19 Nov 2026, "Review my own games live as well"), a game nobody of his plays opens as a review that grows with no tap when a move arrives, and the requests are spaced. Batch 14 adds the two listed limits: TC-R247i, with the switch on the games box keeps the height it has with the switch off and the page does not scroll (the games in progress are the top of the games box); TC-R247j, the summary's in-progress words (the moves, and the time it was checked) each sit whole on one line, never cut, and their block keeps its height as the review grows. NOT COVERED: a real chess.com response (the fixture is built from the API's documented shape; the network is closed in the container); the game-has-ended line and a game that ends while its review is open; a Chess960 Daily game; the Menu switch row's own tap; the growth on the move screen and the silence after closing are read at 375x761 only; his phone. The two summary breaks must fail at 320x568 only: at 375 the old one-line wording ran 352px into 351 at 12:29 AM, so whether it wraps there depends on the clock (a one-digit hour fits), and the gate reads the real time.

breaks.name: list-shows-with-the-switch-off
breaks.why: the feature no longer asks whether the switch is on: with the developer tools on and the switch never turned on, the games in progress are listed and chess.com's in-progress list is asked for

breaks.name: review-does-not-grow
breaks.why: the open review still asks chess.com about its game but never takes a new move in, so it stays at the moves it was opened with

breaks.name: own-game-waits-again
breaks.why: the own-game wait is back (LIVE_OWN_GAMES_WAIT true): a game in progress that one of his own accounts plays in says its review opens when it ends and a tap on it opens nothing, against his 19 Nov answer that his own games are reviewed live too

breaks.name: in-progress-above-the-games-box
breaks.why: the games in progress sit above the games box again, as in batch 13: the box's fit falls to its 88px floor at 375x761 (204 with the switch off) and at 320x568 the page scrolls and the box goes under the tab bar

breaks.name: summary-words-on-one-wrapping-line-again
breaks.why: the summary's in-progress words are one string again ('In progress - N moves so far - checked h:mm AM') that wraps where it runs out, so the time is split over two lines

breaks.name: summary-time-cut-off-the-moves-line
breaks.why: the time is put back on the moves line, which is kept to one line with an ellipsis, so the time it was checked is cut off instead of shown
